title: ServiceNow’s AI-Powered Workplace Enhances Smart Building Management with VergeSense
summary: ServiceNow’s new smart building integration with VergeSense brings real-time occupancy insights to Workplace Service Delivery, optimizing space efficiency.
body_markdown:
By: Facilities Dive


ServiceNow has expanded its Workplace Service Delivery platform with new AI-driven capabilities, including real-time space insights from VergeSense. This integration empowers workplace leaders to make smarter, data-informed decisions around in-person collaboration, hybrid work planning, and space optimization.


[Read More](https://www.facilitiesdive.com/news/vergesense-launches-ai-powered-virtual-assistant-for-facilities-optimization/716435/)
